title: Reachability and bounded balls
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $s,K\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $2^{(2W+2)(s+\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+2)}\le K$, where $W$ is the encoding chunk width of $N$. The following are equivalent: for every $j$ with $0<j\le K$, every code in the ball of radius $j$ formed from initial codes below $K$ using the one-step relation is not accepting; and every code reachable from the initial configuration code by finitely many one-step transitions is not accepting.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input
The bounded-ball condition ranges over every $j$ with $0<j\le K$

Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $x$ be a
